job.title: Live Commerce Quality Assurance Specialist
job.description:
About Our Client

Our Client is a prominent provider of digital and ecommerce solutions across Southeast Asia. They deliver comprehensive omnichannel management, live streaming, video content creation, affiliate marketing for social commerce, and full-spectrum digital marketing services. Their advanced in-house technology supports a diverse portfolio of international brands operating across major marketplaces and social media platforms in six SEA countries. Renowned for their data-driven, growth-oriented approach and a highly skilled team, they are recognized for their innovative marketing and technological capabilities.

As a rapidly expanding organization and exclusive partner of Flywheel in the region, they present numerous opportunities to collaborate with leading brands across various sectors. Joining their team means engaging with the forefront of digital and social commerce in SEA, gaining firsthand experience in managing successful ecommerce operations from start to finish.

Team Overview

The Social Commerce division is a dynamic and expanding group pioneering live shopping, short-form video content, and affiliate marketing throughout Southeast Asia. The team partners with top-tier brands, blending creativity, data insights, and platform expertise to generate tangible commercial outcomes. As part of a comprehensive ecommerce ecosystem, team members gain broad operational exposure, work alongside cross-functional specialists, and influence how brands connect with online consumers in real time.

Your Role and Responsibilities

  • Monitoring Live Broadcasts: Assess the clarity of communication, tone, and energy levels of hosts during live sessions. Ensure all content complies with platform community standards (such as TikTok and Shopee) to avoid penalties or restrictions.
  • Providing Real-Time Feedback: Act as a live director by delivering instant coaching to hosts through private channels. Correct misinformation, suggest content adjustments, and help boost engagement metrics when necessary.
  • Audience Engagement Oversight: Supervise live chat interactions to foster a positive customer experience. Filter spam, address urgent product questions promptly, and maintain a safe, brand-aligned environment.
  • Post-Session Analysis: Compile detailed daily reports on host performance, identify friction points in the customer journey, and document any technical or content issues encountered.
  • Content and USP Verification: Conduct pre- and mid-broadcast audits to ensure hosts are well-versed in product USPs and brand messaging, aligned with campaign guidelines.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in Communications, Marketing, or Management.
  • Experience: Demonstrated background in quality assurance, customer experience, or digital content creation, with familiarity in live commerce environments being a plus.
  • Location: Based in Yogyakarta or open to relocation, with availability for periodic team meetings and strategic workshops.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in interpreting live data such as viewership, click-through rates, and engagement patterns to guide coaching efforts.
  • Attention to Detail: Sharp observational skills to detect nuances in speech, body language, and adherence to SOPs.
  • Communication Skills: Ability to deliver clear, objective, and constructive feedback to hosts effectively.

What We Offer

Joining this organization means working with a portfolio of renowned international brands, producing engaging live streams and video content that meet high standards. This role provides valuable industry exposure and growth opportunities, with many former team members advancing to prominent brand ambassador roles or building large online followings. The company’s integrated approach combines creative innovation with data analytics, empowering you to analyze performance metrics and optimize content effectively.

With a truly global outlook, the organization leverages regional insights to implement best practices across markets. You will be part of a stable yet agile environment that values collaboration, transparency, and continuous learning. The company fosters a culture of support, celebrating achievements together and encouraging a healthy work-life balance through team activities and social events.

Additional Benefits

Employees are encouraged to take initiative and contribute ideas that can shape the company's future. They have access to formal training programs, mentorship, and hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology and processes. Competitive compensation packages, comprehensive health coverage, and generous leave policies are provided to ensure your well-being and job satisfaction. This is an environment where your professional development is prioritized, and your contributions are truly valued.

job.description:
Join Our Client as a Senior Risk Analyst in the Financial Sector

Our Client is seeking a dedicated Risk Analyst to help oversee and refine their financial risk management strategies within Singapore. This role offers the chance to work with a vibrant team, engaging with a diverse array of financial products and tackling intricate risk challenges. It’s an excellent opportunity for professionals eager to expand their expertise across multiple facets of risk analysis and management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in designing and maintaining a comprehensive risk management framework, ensuring compliance with internal policies and evolving regulatory standards.
  • Perform daily risk control activities such as margin calculations, mark-to-market valuations, and generating risk reports, collaborating closely with Clearing Operations teams to mitigate clearing risks.
  • Investigate instances of margin breaches or risk limit exceedances, conducting root cause analyses, communicating with members, and managing escalation procedures, all while maintaining detailed audit records.
  • Support the calculation and oversight of option margin requirements using portfolio margining techniques like SPAN and VaR, reviewing volatility surfaces, stress scenarios, and option Greeks for complex positions.
  • Manage non-cash collateral assets, including government securities, letters of credit, and emerging digital assets, while evaluating collateral valuation methods and operational procedures such as digital token transfers.
  • Monitor collateral sufficiency and concentration limits across clearing members, ensuring daily reconciliation of posted collateral against margin needs and guarantee fund contributions.
  • Develop and maintain reports for management, regulatory bodies, and members, providing insights into risk exposures and operational metrics.

job.title: Senior Investment & Strategy Manager – Real Estate & Private Capital
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with various business units to shape and implement the organization’s strategic planning cycle, aligning growth objectives and capital distribution priorities into a comprehensive annual plan.
  • Collaborate closely with senior leadership and department heads to execute approved corporate strategies, supporting initiatives such as market entry feasibility studies, mergers and acquisitions, and strategic alliances.
  • Develop and deliver detailed reports and presentations on a monthly and quarterly basis to keep executive teams and boards informed, crafting compelling visuals to facilitate strategic decision-making.
  • Assist in raising capital by managing relationships with investors, overseeing the investor pipeline, and coordinating roadshows for new funds in sectors like hospitality and student housing.
  • Prepare marketing documents such as offering memoranda, teasers, and pitch decks, translating complex investment opportunities into engaging narratives for potential investors.
  • Maintain the Due Diligence Questionnaire (DDQ) database, coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely and accurate responses to investor inquiries.
  • Supervise the investor onboarding process, ensuring compliance with anti-money laundering and source of wealth checks through third-party service providers.
  • Oversee fund operations, including capital calls and distributions, to optimize cash flow and ensure accurate investor allocations.
  • Generate quarterly performance reports and newsletters to keep investors updated on fund results and strategic outlooks.
  • Conduct thorough reviews of financial models and materials submitted by business units, validating assumptions and ensuring alignment with investment strategies before approval.
  • Manage the investment committee process, ensuring all submissions are comprehensive, standardized, and meet institutional standards.
  • Build and maintain fund-level financial models to monitor overall returns, forecast carried interest, and assess the impact of new acquisitions on fund performance.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned, demonstrating professionalism and diligence in all tasks.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Academic background in Finance, Economics, Real Estate, or related disciplines; professional designations such as CFA or CA/CPA are preferred or in progress.
  • Between four and seven years of relevant experience in areas like investment banking, private equity, real estate fund management, or corporate strategy within a real estate development environment.
  • Proven track record in capital raising activities, including creating offering documents, managing due diligence, and engaging with limited partners, preferably in real estate sectors.
  • Exceptional proficiency in Excel, especially in analyzing large datasets and scenario modeling.
  • Self-driven with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects efficiently.
  • Experience reviewing legal documents such as partnership agreements and loan contracts, with an understanding of commercial terms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of producing impactful presentations for senior stakeholders and investors.
  • Exposure to preparing board-level materials or familiarity with reporting cycles of publicly listed companies is advantageous.

Additional Benefits

  • Opportunity to work within a dynamic team focused on innovative real estate investment strategies.
  • Supportive environment that encourages professional growth and development.
  • Competitive compensation package complemented by comprehensive health and wellness programs.
  • Flexible work arrangements designed to promote work-life balance.
  • Access to a broad network of industry professionals and investors, fostering valuable connections.

job.title: Revenue Analytics Specialist for Hospitality Portfolio
job.description:
Position Overview

Our Client is seeking a detail-oriented professional to join their revenue management team, focusing on serviced residences and hotel properties within Singapore. Reporting directly to the Area Director of Revenue Management, you will play a key role in analyzing data and generating insights to support strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain business intelligence dashboards that track booking velocity, demand indicators, customer segments, and industry benchmarks.
  • Perform variance analysis on critical performance metrics such as average daily rate (ADR), revenue per available room (RevPAR), occupancy rates, and channel performance.
  • Examine patterns in length of stay, customer segmentation, and demand fluctuations to identify potential risks and growth opportunities.
  • Construct scenario models to evaluate the effects of group bookings, seasonal promotions, and market shifts.
  • Identify and communicate emerging risks or unusual trends to the leadership team proactively.
  • Build accurate forecasting models tailored to the serviced residences and hotel portfolio, supporting budgeting and planning processes.
  • Contribute insights to financial forecasts, budget preparations, and strategic planning initiatives.
  • Identify repetitive manual reporting tasks and implement automation solutions to improve efficiency.
  • Standardize reporting formats across properties to ensure consistency and clarity.
  • Collaborate with IT and other departments to enhance business intelligence tools and dashboards, aligning them with evolving business needs.
  • Support management meetings and reports with detailed analysis, translating data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Work closely with Sales and Marketing teams to evaluate the impact of promotional activities, contracts, and campaigns.
  • Assist in process improvements to streamline reporting and data analysis workflows.

Goals & Impact

  • Enhance the depth and quality of revenue reporting through advanced analytics and predictive insights.
  • Provide timely, strategic insights to help leadership anticipate market trends and adjust strategies accordingly.
  • Reduce manual effort by automating routine tasks and standardizing reporting procedures.
  • Support the team in making data-driven decisions that maximize revenue potential.
  • Contribute to continuous process improvements to increase operational efficiency.

Candidate Profile

  • Degree holder in Business, Finance, Hospitality, Information Technology, or related fields.
  • No prior experience necessary; fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
  • Strong analytical and numerical skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookup functions, scenario analysis, and automation techniques.
  • Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau is advantageous.
  • Knowledge of hotel management systems (HMS, PMS, CRS, RMS) is a plus.
  • Understanding of revenue management principles, including segmentation, channel performance, displacement analysis, and forecasting methods.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of presenting insights in a clear and concise manner.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of identifying trends and anomalies independently.
